The most detailed engravings require normal OpenType shaping, which assembles their complete outlines automatically. Software with shaping disabled displays a simplified compatibility outline. Use the SVG for full detail in those applications.

Use this icon in HTML

Download every part: Web bundle ZIP 1 of 2 Web bundle ZIP 2 of 2. Extract all parts into the same folder, then place the collection folder beside your HTML file. Together the parts include all SVGs, PNGs, fonts, CSS, instructions and license notices. Keep the subfolders together for these examples.

Three-tone image

This displays all three tones with a transparent background. Set the height; the width follows the original proportions.

<img src="collection/caslon-cuts-1841/svg/multitone/caslon-1841-p378-cut-153.svg"
     alt="Hope seated on rocks beside an anchor" height="96">

An image has its own colour context, so page CSS cannot recolour its internal regions. For a decorative image beside a text label, use alt="".

Three-tone with your own colours

On an HTTP(S) page, load the sprite from the same site. This complete example uses dark primary ink and two strengths of red. Each region has an independent colour and opacity; set the secondary and tertiary values alike for a two-tone appearance.

<style>
  .revival-cut {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 96px;
    height: 1em;
    width: 0.941406em;
    vertical-align: middle;
    --fr-primary-color: #24251f;
    --fr-secondary-color: #a5422c;
    --fr-tertiary-color: #a5422c;
    --fr-primary-opacity: 1;
    --fr-secondary-opacity: 0.55;
    --fr-tertiary-opacity: 0.25;
  }
</style>
<svg class="revival-cut" role="img" aria-label="Hope seated on rocks beside an anchor">
  <use href="collection/caslon-cuts-1841/web/icons-multitone-11.svg#caslon-1841-p378-cut-153"></use>
</svg>

Monochrome icon font

Copy the whole web/ folder, including CSS and webfonts. Font size and colour use ordinary CSS. The icon font draws the solid version; use SVG for three-tone artwork.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="collection/caslon-cuts-1841/web/icons.css">
<span class="fr-icon fr-caslon-1841-p378-cut-153" aria-hidden="true"
      style="font-size:96px;color:#a5422c"></span>
<span>Hope seated on rocks beside an anchor</span>

The decorative font icon is hidden from screen readers and has a visible text label. An icon conveying meaning on its own needs role="img" and an aria-label instead of aria-hidden.
